verdict.line: You lose if he lands E (Apprehend) pre-6 and chains it into stacked Hemorrhage before you can disengage; you win if you poke with E (Test of Spirit) from range and fight on top of your Tentacles.

brief.thesis: This lane is structurally even — Illaoi wins it 51.4% of the time over 1122 games — because her E (Test of Spirit, 900 range) outranges everything Darius has, letting her farm Vessels and Tentacle damage from a distance his E (Apprehend, 535 range) can't reach. The entire lane is a contest of whether you poke safely from outside his pull range or get dragged into his stacking-bleed combo before you have the tools to answer.

theirWindow.what: If he pulls you in, expect Q (Decimate) and autos stacking Hemorrhage immediately after — back out the moment the spirit from your E resolves rather than standing in his Q's circle to trade further.

yourWindow.when: You land E near one of your Tentacles
yourWindow.what: Fight him there — the echoed spirit damage plus a Tentacle swing adds up fast, and if he disengages before the spirit timer ends he becomes a Vessel, spawning more Tentacles that chip him down and heal you off every champion hit.

start.why: The sustain and early AD let you win extended trades where Tentacles are swinging, which matters more here than the shield from Doran's Shield since you're not tanking his hardest hits from range.

boots.why: Darius's damage is almost entirely auto-attacks and physical ability hits layering Hemorrhage stacks — flat damage reduction on autos directly slows his stack-up.

core.why: The armor shred compounds with every E (Harsh Lesson) and Q (Tentacle Smash) hit, and the AD/health base gives you the stats to not lose straight trades.
Adds a slow proc off your abilities so you can stick a Vessel conversion or punish him trying to walk away mid-trade.
The bonus health and damage-reduction shield is a direct answer to his Noxian Guillotine true-damage execute threat once he hits level 6.

situational.when: he is ahead and threatening to all-in you off a stacked Hemorrhage + Guillotine combo
the game goes long and you want more healing off your Tentacles and passive
you are ahead and want to snowball dueling power off crits

runes.keystoneWhy: It procs off autos every 4 seconds during extended trades, which stacks naturally with how long Test of Spirit fights run — you out-sustain his bleed instead of racing it.

summoners.why: Flash is non-negotiable to dodge his E (Apprehend) pull pre-6 per measured lane data; Teleport is the top pick here (52.1% win rate) since the lane is even and you can convert that neutrality into map pressure elsewhere, while Exhaust or Ignite trade some scaling for safer or more aggressive all-ins.

playing.title: Respect E (Apprehend) before level 6
playing.detail: Without Flash up, stay outside his 535-range pull and farm with Q (Tentacle Smash) instead of standing in range to trade.

playing.title: Poke with E at max range
playing.detail: Test of Spirit's 900 range outranges his entire kit — land it from distance and force him to either eat echoed damage or back off into a Vessel conversion.

playing.title: Fight on top of your Tentacles
playing.detail: Your passive spawns Tentacles on nearby walls; drag trades into that radius for free damage and the on-hit heal.

playing.title: Track his Hemorrhage stacks
playing.detail: At 5 stacks he enrages with a big AD spike — disengage before he caps stacks rather than trading through his strongest window.

playing.title: Play around his level-6 all-in
playing.detail: Noxian Guillotine deals true damage scaled by his stacks and refreshes on a kill — don't let him sit at 4-5 stacks on you right as he hits 6.

playing.title: Use W to punish his overextensions
playing.detail: Harsh Lesson's 4-second cooldown lets you leap in repeatedly — use it to finish trades or punish him stepping up for a last hit.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured from live games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: A pre-level 6 Illaoi will most likely be killed if she is pulled by Darius’s (E) if you do not use Flash. Try to stay outside the range of (E) and farm with your [Q]. Even after you strike him with [E], fall back if Darius closes in to use (E). If you must engage in close quarters, be careful not to stay in range of his (Q).
